source_text: Sacerdos mundum pronuntiat cum sanitas redit. Christus absolvit. Noli redire ad vomitum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Priest clean pronounces when health returns. Christ absolves. Do-not return to vomit. Amen.
pass_b_english: The priest pronounces clean when health returns. Christ absolves. [[Do not return to the vomit >> Bible:2 Peter 2:22]]. Homilia VIII CLOSEOUT. Amen.
